title: Uncloud x Le Guess Who? — Jacobikerk
excerpt: Co-curating the Uncloud programme at Le Guess Who? 2022 and turning the Jacobikerk into an immersive projected space.
description:
For Le Guess Who? 2022 I co-curated the Uncloud programme together with Skander Jaïbi, Bob van Heur and Jacob Hagelaars, and turned the historic Jacobikerk in Utrecht into an immersive projected space for the concerts — with performances by Mabe Fratti, Hatis Noit, Hinako Omori, Max Cooper and Sote & Tarik Barri.
> Working with the church's gothic architecture, light wrapped the nave and its chandeliers in slow, shifting colour — turning the building itself into an instrument of atmosphere. Through the concerts I played light and image live, letting the space breathe with each performance.
credits: Programme co-curated by Jaco Schilp, Skander Jaïbi, Bob van Heur & Jacob Hagelaars for Uncloud. Light design & projection: Jaco Schilp, with Skander Jaïbi and Cris Molle. Presented at Le Guess Who? 2022, Jacobikerk, Utrecht. Photography: Paulus van Dorsten.
